name: shimmer
title: Shimmer
summary: A label with a moving sheen that says work is under way.
description: A label with a moving sheen that says work is under way: an agent thinking, a page loading. Shimmering label: signals the agent is processing. A moving ink highlight clipped to the text; tone accent sweeps in the accent hue.

tone.description: ink or accent: accent text with an accent-ink highlight (fine-tune-card's "Adjust" hint).

notes: The text is real text. Put the shimmer in a role="status" region when it announces work in progress.

motion: background-position sweep, 1.8s linear, forever (1.4s when fast)
prefers-reduced-motion: the sweep stops and the label shows as static ink-2 text (accent text for tone accent)
forced-colors: static system text colour (background images are dropped there)
